name: Lena April
source:
The princess of the Ales Empire, and [url=/c90424]Leticia's[/url] older sister. Thought becoming the Queen would be a pain, so she passed on that responsibility to her little sister. An aggressive and masculine type that wields a huge sword, but flimsy armor (so as to not restrict movement, of course). Insists she doesn't just have an exhibition fetish.
